betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Why walk across a planet when you can hover? The §6Hovercraft§f gives you fast ground transportation that crosses water, lava, and small gaps without building roads or railways.

Vanilla recipe: Advanced Batteries, User Interface, dilithium gems, structure tower, and monopropellant rocket engines. Burns 500 RF/t while hovering. The GUI throttle controls speed, and it hovers 1 block above the ground.

It can't climb hills steeper than 30 degrees, so plan your routes around steep terrain. The Advanced Battery is the energy source and must be recharged at a Battery Charger after extended use.

§ePS:§f Stockpile 4 batteries for a 20-minute exploration trip. Pair with a Space Suit for vacuum worlds and a Beacon network for waypoint navigation.
